summary: legal checked in 9 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Legal risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, or advertising. Official Woot documentation establishes API access mechanics only; current public terms restrict commercial/public collection, display, derivative use, and data mining. No written permission or field-level rights are evidenced. Human counsel is required for upstream data rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Keep the product private and preview-only; keep outreach unsent pending counsel review and owner authorization.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks are closed and 4 remain open. No task is closed because direct evidence is still missing. Progress is limited to official API/terms/support review, partial repository/configuration data-flow evidence, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft site terms. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is BLOCKED. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, and limits for storage, derivatives, caching, public display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademarks, images, prices, affiliate use, and advertising. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized outreach or launch decision.

Data-use review: user alert rules and sync results are EVIDENCE_NEEDED. The purpose and processing are understandable, but data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, Slack/email processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are not evidenced. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table; do not expand alerts.

Data-use review: GA4 analytics is EVIDENCE_NEEDED, not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry. The stated measurement-only purpose and consent-gated processing are conditionally acceptable if implemented as described, but deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment are not evidenced. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling new tracking, remarketing, or advertising.

Data-use review: operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are EVIDENCE_NEEDED. Operational use is conditionally supportable, but log fields, retention/access controls, vendor coverage, incident response, subpoena handling, and data-subject-request procedures are not evidenced. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, incident, and request inventory. No secondary disclosure or monetization is cleared.

Fleet legal disposition: ordinary reversible growth is CONDITIONAL, not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry, when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked where compliance, security, launch, accuracy, or measurement evidence is incomplete. Technical compliance baseline is 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown; revenue is $4.92 aggregate and unattributed for 2026-09-21. Do not treat unavailable telemetry as zero or as legal clearance.

Private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each property covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence.

Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only. Rights outreach remains unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization; no public display, alert expansion, affiliate use, advertising, deployment, configuration change, or credential change is cleared. Continue the existing consolidated read-only evidence bundle.
